sources.name: OpenAI Help Center: How do I cancel my ChatGPT subscription?
Engadget: How to cancel your ChatGPT subscription

caption:
Canceling ChatGPT Plus or Pro is a Settings, then Billing job on the web, but on iPhone and Android the subscription lives with Apple or Google.
Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal and you keep paid features until the period ends.
Your saved chats stay in your account.

Have you ever paid for an AI plan you forgot to cancel?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: OpenAI Help Center, Engadget · Photo: 9to5Mac
threads_text: Canceling ChatGPT Plus or Pro takes a minute on the web, but if you paid through Apple or Google you have to cancel there, and deleting the app cancels nothing. Your chats stay either way. Have you ever paid for an AI plan you forgot about?

slides.headline: How to cancel *ChatGPT Plus or Pro*, and keep your chats

slides.heading: 1. On the web: *Settings, Billing*
paras: On chatgpt.com, open the account menu, choose Settings, then Billing. Under Cancel plan, select Cancel.
Paid features stay on until the period you paid for ends.

slides.heading: 2. iPhone: *Apple's Settings*
paras: Paid in the iPhone app? Open iPhone Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions, ChatGPT and Cancel Subscription.
Deleting the app does not cancel anything.

slides.heading: 3. Android: *Google Play*
paras: Open the Play Store, go to Subscriptions, pick ChatGPT and tap Cancel subscription.
Sign in with the same Google account that paid for it.

slides.heading: 4. Your chats *stay*
paras: Canceling does not delete your account. Saved chats stay until you delete them.

paras.t: Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal, or the next charge may already go through.

site_article.headline: ChatGPT cancel subscription: how to stop Plus or Pro on web, iPhone and Android
site_article.dek: Where you cancel depends on who bills you. Here are the steps for each platform, the 24 hour rule, what happens to your chats and how refunds work.
site_article.summary: To cancel a ChatGPT subscription bought on chatgpt.com, open Settings, then Billing, and select Cancel under Cancel plan. Plans bought through the iPhone app or Google Play are canceled in Apple's or Google's subscription settings, and in every case paid features last until the current billing period ends.
site_article.seo_title: ChatGPT cancel subscription: Plus or Pro on web, iPhone, Android
site_article.seo_description: Step by step: cancel ChatGPT Plus or Pro on chatgpt.com, iPhone and Android, the 24 hour rule, what happens to your chats, and how to ask for a refund.
site_article.answer_summary: On chatgpt.com, open the account menu, go to Settings, then Billing, and select Cancel under Cancel plan. If you paid through Apple or Google Play, cancel in that store's subscription settings. Do it at least 24 hours before your next billing date.
site_article.hero_alt: The ChatGPT logo on a green background.

paragraphs.text: To cancel a ChatGPT subscription, you have to cancel in the same place that bills you. If you paid on chatgpt.com, you cancel in ChatGPT's own billing settings. If you paid inside the iPhone app or through Google Play, Apple or Google runs the subscription, and that is where it has to be stopped. OpenAI's help center says the same steps apply to personal plans and to self-service ChatGPT Business workspaces, while Enterprise and Edu plans are handled by an admin.

The one deadline to remember: cancel at least 24 hours before your next billing date. OpenAI says a cancellation made inside that window may come too late to stop the renewal charge. After a normal cancellation, you keep paid features until the end of the current billing period.
If you are not sure who bills you, open the receipt for your last charge. It shows whether the payment went to OpenAI, Apple or Google, and that tells you which set of steps below to use.
How to cancel a ChatGPT subscription on the web

paragraphs.title: 1. Sign in on chatgpt.com
paragraphs.text: Use the account that has the paid plan. One subscription covers every device you sign in on, so you only cancel once.

paragraphs.title: 2. Open Settings, then Billing
paragraphs.text: Open the account menu from your profile and choose Settings, then the Billing section.

paragraphs.title: 3. Cancel the plan
paragraphs.text: Under Cancel plan, select Cancel and confirm. Then check the billing page again to make sure the plan is no longer set to renew.
How to cancel ChatGPT on iPhone or iPad

paragraphs.title: 1. Open the iPhone Settings app
paragraphs.text: Not the ChatGPT app. Apple manages subscriptions bought through the App Store.

paragraphs.title: 2. Find the subscription
paragraphs.text: Tap your name at the top, then Subscriptions, then ChatGPT.

paragraphs.title: 3. Cancel
paragraphs.text: Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm. If there is no cancel button and you see an expiration date instead, the subscription is probably already canceled.
How to cancel ChatGPT on Android

paragraphs.title: 1. Open the Google Play Store
paragraphs.text: Make sure you are signed in with the Google account that made the purchase.

paragraphs.title: 2. Cancel in Subscriptions
paragraphs.text: Go to Subscriptions, select ChatGPT, tap Cancel subscription and follow the prompts. On a computer, open your Google Play subscriptions page, select Manage next to ChatGPT, then Cancel subscription.
Things that do not cancel your plan

Uninstalling the app does not cancel a subscription. Deleting your ChatGPT account cancels subscriptions billed by OpenAI, but it does not cancel subscriptions billed by Apple or Google Play, so OpenAI says to cancel those first. Engadget adds that web, Apple and Google subscriptions are managed separately, so it is possible to have more than one running at the same time.
If you were charged twice, check every Apple ID, Google account and ChatGPT login you have used. Cancel the extra subscription on the platform that bills it.
What happens to your chats after you cancel

Canceling stops future renewals but does not delete your account or your history. Engadget notes that saved chats stay in your account until you delete them. Deleting the account is a separate, permanent step.

If you want your chats kept but not used to train models, Engadget points to the Improve the model for everyone switch under Settings, then Data Controls. Turning it off does not remove existing conversations.
Refunds and lost logins

Canceling does not refund past charges. OpenAI says refunds for purchases made on chatgpt.com or through Google Play are requested through OpenAI support while signed in to the account that was charged, and App Store purchases have to be refunded by Apple. Eligibility depends on the purchase and where you live. Engadget reports that customers in the EU, the UK and Turkey can get a prorated refund if they cancel within 14 days of purchase, and that if a refund is granted, the paid access tied to that charge usually ends early.

If you cannot sign in to a subscription billed by OpenAI, contact OpenAI support with the account or billing email and two of these: the last four digits of the card, its expiration date, the billing address or the date of the most recent charge. OpenAI says never to send the full card number. For Apple or Google subscriptions, cancel through the store account that paid, or ask Apple or Google to help recover it.

The two easy traps are the same as with most app subscriptions: deleting the app while the store subscription keeps running, and canceling on the last day before renewal. Cancel early in the billing period, in the place that charges you, and you lose nothing, because paid features keep working until the period ends and your chats stay where they are.
